referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA contributes only a few catalogue flux points (about 2.5 % error) to a spectrum dominated by single-dish and VLBI data; ALMA-specific reduction is not described
Abstract B_SSA limits (>7 mG LSS) differ from the Section 3.3 text (>37 mG before the 2014 flare), so the quoted numbers depend on epoch selection
Doppler factors are borrowed from literature and assigned by distance from core; b(alpha) varies by 2x, so B_SSA (steeply dependent on d_m and nu_m) is highly uncertain
Double-SSA decomposition is under-constrained with sparse low-frequency points and 30-day bins; sampler and priors are not given
Quiescent spectrum rests on four frequencies; 340 GHz values are extrapolated rather than measured
